source_stage.description: Clean text pairs with lowercasing, spelling correction, synonym or query expansion, punctuation handling, and domain-specific token normalization.
guarantees: Pair order and normalized tokens are explicit.

source_stage_review.realization: Apply NFKC/casefold, existing spelling correction, word punctuation handling, explicit domain substitutions and one-pass synonym expansion; reject split collisions after normalization.
source_stage_review.limits: Caller supplies a frozen vocabulary and mappings. Empty mappings express identity policy. No semantic correctness or external vocabulary fitting claim.

source_stage.description: Compute n-gram overlap, Jaccard on descriptions, cosine TF-IDF matching, Levenshtein/edit distance on titles, BM25, exact match, and length-ratio features for each pair.
guarantees: Features are aligned one row per text pair.

source_stage_review.realization: Retain character n-gram overlap, token Jaccard, TF-IDF cosine, normalized edit similarity, exact match and length ratio; append symmetric BM25 with training-only corpus statistics.
source_stage_review.limits: Two generic normalized text fields, without distinct title/description subfields. BM25 query terms have unit weight, corpus documents are unique training texts, and positive IDF is explicit. Field-role contract must be declared at the external boundary.

source_stage.description: Compute similarity from GloVe, Word2Vec, LSA/SVD, LDA topic vectors, averaged token vectors, or sentence embeddings.
guarantees: Semantic feature rows match the pair table.

source_stage_review.realization: Select the listed LSA/SVD branch with reusable sparse randomized projection fit and transform; append latent cosine and Euclidean distance.
source_stage_review.limits: Training-only TF-IDF and uncentered randomized projection. No pretrained embedding or topic-model branch claimed.

source_stage.description: Add pair graph degree, duplicate-neighborhood, transitive-closure, candidate frequency, category, or magic features computed with leakage-safe splits.

source_stage_review.realization: Select unlabeled pair graph degree, neighborhood overlap and pair frequency; exclude the current edge for training feature rows.
source_stage_review.limits: Only candidate-pair co-occurrence, not semantic equivalence. Population isolation is normalized unordered pair identity, not entity-disjoint splitting; caller must meet any stronger application split requirements.

source_stage.description: Train XGBoost, LightGBM, SVR, logistic regression, random forest, ranking heads, or blended models on the combined lexical, embedding, and context features.
guarantees: Each input pair receives a raw score.

source_stage_review.realization: Fit scaled logistic regression and a random forest over all thirteen features; combine ordered probability vectors with the reusable equal mean.
source_stage_review.limits: Model family, equal weights and controls are explicit recipe policy. No benchmark accuracy claim.

source_stage.description: Calibrate Jaccard, cosine, or Levenshtein thresholds; Kendall Tau or ranking objectives; target normalization to a 0-1 range; relevance-score scaling; or transitive closure against the competition metric.
guarantees: Outputs are calibrated and formatted for submission.

source_stage_review.realization: Select the listed relevance-score scaling branch: fit increasing isotonic regression on held-out raw scores and binary labels, bound to [0,1], clip outside calibration score range, then select an empirical binary-F1 threshold.
source_stage_review.limits: Mapping and threshold share the calibration population; selection F1 is optimistic and not independent evaluation. Raw and scaled scores are distinguished. Strict serialized output and generic submission row format remain to be qualified; no competition-specific format is claimed.

remaining_requirements: Qualify the existing isotonic provider branch and source dependencies; a local registered implementation is not proof of catalog approval.
Complete reusable primitive inventory and exact callable bindings, including BM25 and normalization dependencies.
Provide strict finite serialization with explicit field roles, normalization policy, numerical controls and binary-relevance output rows.
Execute the full serialized/stored original graph and verify exact catalog interfaces, rollback, native eligibility and served selection.
limits: Scope mapping only; no full graph, submission format, provider approval or original-CDG approval claim.
The binary relevance task is a declared realization of the generic topology, not every listed competition metric.
